Student.title: Student
Student.description: A school student record with parent WhatsApp contact information.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated educator or school administrator.

fullName.description: Full name of the student (1 to 100 chars).

studentCode.description: School roll number or student ID code (1 to 40 chars).

gradeClass.description: Class or grade level (1 to 50 chars).

parentName.description: Full name of the parent or guardian (1 to 100 chars).

parentWhatsApp.description: Parent WhatsApp phone number in international format (5 to 30 chars).

attendanceDays.description: Number of days attended this term (0 to 366).

totalTermDays.description: Total number of school days in the term (1 to 366).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ReportCard.title: ReportCard
ReportCard.description: An academic term report card for a student with subject grades and WhatsApp dispatch tracking.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated educator or school administrator.

studentId.description: Reference ID of the student document (1 to 128 chars).

studentCode.description: Student code or roll number (1 to 40 chars).

gradeClass.description: Class or grade level (1 to 50 chars).

parentName.description: Parent or guardian name (1 to 100 chars).

schoolName.description: Name of the school issuing the report card (1 to 120 chars).

academicTerm.description: Academic term and year label (1 to 60 chars).

attendanceSummary.description: Formatted attendance summary string (1 to 40 chars).

subjectsSummary.description: Pipe-and-newline delimited subject breakdown rows: Subject|Score|Grade|Remark (1 to 1500 chars).

classPosition.description: Rank or position in class (1 to 30 chars).

teacherRemarks.description: Form teacher or principal remarks (1 to 500 chars).

principalSignature.description: Signatory name and title (1 to 100 chars).

dispatchCount.description: Number of times this report card has been dispatched via WhatsApp.

lastSentAt.description: Human-readable timestamp of the last WhatsApp send (0 to 60 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report card was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the report card was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A WhatsApp-style chat message or dispatched report card entry in a parent conversation thread.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated educator or school administrator.

threadKey.description: Normalized parent phone digits or student thread identifier (1 to 60 chars).

studentId.description: Optional student document ID (0 to 128 chars).

studentName.description: Student name associated with this parent chat (1 to 100 chars).

parentName.description: Parent or guardian display name (1 to 100 chars).

parentWhatsApp.description: Parent WhatsApp number in international format (5 to 30 chars).

direction.description: Message direction: outgoing from school or incoming logged reply from parent.

messageText.description: Message body or report card caption (1 to 1500 chars).

attachmentFileId.description: Local uploaded report card ID if a file was attached (0 to 128 chars).

attachmentFileName.description: Filename of the attached PDF or image report card (0 to 140 chars).

attachmentMimeType.description: MIME type of the attached report card (0 to 60 chars).

sentTimeLabel.description: Formatted display time for the chat bubble (1 to 60 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat message was logged.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat message was last updated.

/users/{userId}/students/{studentId}.description: User-scoped collection of students and parent WhatsApp contacts.

/users/{userId}/report_cards/{reportId}.description: User-scoped collection of academic report cards and WhatsApp delivery statuses.

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{messageId.description: User-scoped WhatsApp chat history and dispatched report card log per parent.
